hypothesis: A CNO initialized from the released simulation-only checkpoint and fine-tuned only on E002 training real fields will beat persistence on all four quality subscores: relative L2, TKE, MVPE, and SPS.

data.normalization: per-channel Gaussian statistics over every training-window element

training.loss: normalized MSE over u, v, and zero-pressure channels
training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final update; no validation-based early stopping

external_code_audit.use: Audited CNO/Adam/cosine/normalized-MSE semantics; upstream code is not copied into the submission.

preflight.reason_for_final_budget: A 10-update RTX 5050 smoke at batch size 4 took 37.24 seconds and peaked at 5,015,075,328 allocated bytes. The initially proposed 1,200 updates would exceed the pre-registered 40-minute cap, so the final budget was reduced before any validation evaluation.
